chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality Ch. 461 – The Spider Silk Gambit
chapter_meta_description: The Extreme Yin Patriarch reveals himself and shatters Han Li’s formation. A single strand of spider silk sets the stage for a deadly three-way standoff over the inner hall’s greatest secret.
og_title: RMJI Ch. 461: The Spider Silk Gambit
og_description: The Extreme Yin Patriarch descends on the Void Heaven Palace, and a fragment of Bloodjade Spider silk turns Han Li into the most wanted man in the hall.
twitter_title: RMJI Ch. 461 – The Spider Silk Gambit
twitter_description: Han Li’s forgotten spirit beast becomes the centerpiece of a Nascent Soul elder’s hidden scheme in this tense, tactical standoff.

lore_anchors.definition: The Nascent Soul overlord of Extreme Yin Island, a demonic-path sect in the Chaotic Star Sea. He is Wu Chou’s ancestor and the “unfilial disciple” of the Profound Bone Saint.

A rare spirit beast whose silk was previously used by Han Li in the Hidden Kill Sect battle; it now draws the attention of a Nascent Soul elder, hinting at a hidden secret tied to the Void Heaven Palace’s inner hall.
A legendary, sentient spirit herb that can transform and is said to be greatly useful for condensing a Nascent Soul. Han Li obtained it just before this confrontation.

The three life-force–condensing stage between Foundation Establishment and Nascent Soul; cultivators at this level can threaten Nascent Soul elders only at extreme risk and usually rely on numbers or ambush.

A virtually undying existence whose soul can survive the destruction of its body and possess another vessel. At this level, cultivators can casually shatter mid-grade formations and command the local environment with raw aura.
The most dangerous and treasure-rich zone of the Void Heaven Palace, closed to Qi Condensation cultivators and extremely dangerous even for Core Formation ones.
A private communication method using spiritual sense that is undetectable to anyone below a certain cultivation level, unless they have a specialized detection art.
A thousand-year-old ghost who sacrificed his physical form and reincarnation for vengeance; the former master of the Extreme Yin Patriarch.
A floating jade palace in the Chaotic Star Sea, a major dungeon location that opens periodically, admitting cultivators of Core Formation and below.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is the Patriarch interested in Han Li’s spider?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The spider’s silk is the key to entering the inner hall’s most restricted area, making Han Li a human unlocking key rather than a simple cultivator.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Han Li refuse the invitation?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He knows that a Nascent Soul cultivator offering “safe passage” is never altruistic—it means he is disposable, and the inner hall is a death trap he has no reason to risk.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Profound Bone Saint’s problem?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He is furious that Han Li concealed the spider, because its existence completely changes the strategic value of their alliance—now he needs Han Li alive more than ever, which limits his own schemes.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is the Profound Bone Saint actually helping Han Li?
cultural_notes_faq.a: No, he is helping himself. He wants Han Li inside the inner hall so he can exploit the spider’s secret to spring a trap on his former disciple.
Wu Chou is the Patriarch’s attack dog. His outburst is a staged escalation to pressure Han Li into compliance without the Patriarch having to issue a direct threat.
